scope: Round 13. SRS.txt 'system - Chatbox with Gemini API - Staff side': a staff chat panel that serves many signed-in customers at once in real time; conversations the bot cannot handle (rate limit or Gemini unavailable) are handed to staff. Off-topic detection, admin approval of db changes (Req-2) and chunking saved data (Req-3) are deferred by the user (2026-11-15). Builds on round 12 (archived as progress-feature-list/feature_list_12.json). Every business rule from rounds 1-12 stays.

source_requirements.text: build me a chat panel for staff role, panel can handle multiple chat with clients, request to save datas to Database. when Agent reach to limit or questions out of scope, the messsge will come into chat panel of staff. Req-1: chat panel can handle multiple clients, in realtime. Req-2: any change tounch into db need approve from admin. Req-3: any datas must be chunked before save to db. Tests: e2e, unit and integration tests written to the e2e folder. Changed files described in docs. All delete mean soft delete.

readings_to_confirm: Gemini: reuse be/rag/chat.py's `client` and GEMINI_MODEL (round 12). No second Gemini config.

'Agent reach to limit' = the existing over_web_limit() (30 calls/min) answering 429, plus Gemini failing (503 after retries). Either makes /api/chat return {handoff: true, reason}. Off-topic detection is deferred (user, 2026-11-15).
Confirmed (user, 2026-11-15): only signed-in customers can be handed to staff (identity from the auction_token cookie, as rag-1.7). Guests get the existing 'log in at /login' note.

Conversations and messages live in Postgres as new Prisma models, served by the Node API (Express + Prisma), because the realtime bus (be/src/lib/events.ts, SSE) is in Node. The browser ChatBox, on {handoff: true}, posts the transcript to Node itself; Flask does not call Node.

Realtime (Req-1) reuses SSE, as rt-001/stf-009: a staff channel 'chat' on the existing staff stream and the customer's own user channel. No socket.io. Limit stays one API process (documented in docs/realtime.md).

Req-2 (admin approval for db changes) and Req-3 (chunk before save) are deferred (user, 2026-11-15: 'change in db skip for now'). The knowledge-request/approval features are kept under `deferred` so the work stays visible. Chat conversations and messages are stored directly.
One conversation is answered by one staff member at a time (claim). A staff member can hold many conversations at once; the panel shows them all and switches without reload.
Delete = soft delete (deletedAt) for conversations, messages and knowledge requests.

Tests: per SRS new unit/integration tests live under e2e/: TypeScript as e2e/unit/*.test.ts and e2e/integration/*.test.ts (vitest, wired into npm test), Python as e2e/py/*_test.py (unittest, wired into npm run test:py). No new Playwright e2e specs this round (user, 2026-11-15: 'don't write e2e test for now'); UI is checked by fe vitest and manual screenshots. Existing test homes and Playwright specs stay and must keep passing.
Node conversation routes live under /api/support (not /api/chat/...): the Vite dev proxy sends every /api/chat* path to the Python bot (sch-1.4).

conventions.tests: See readings_to_confirm: everything new under e2e/. Integration tests use the auction_test database like the existing be suite and skip with a clear message when DATABASE_URL is unreachable. Gemini is stubbed in unit and integration tests; only manual live checks call it. No new Playwright specs (e2e/*.spec.ts) this round.
conventions.existing_tests: All round 1-12 tests (be vitest, fe vitest, be/rag Python, Playwright) must keep passing. be/rag/chat_test.py may change only where a feature documents why.
